name: writing-honest-claims
title_zh: 证据扛不动的话，一个字都不许写进结论
tagline_zh: 分析完想下结论，它先逼你走完「观察到→方向性→决策支持」三级阶梯。因果没设计支撑？直接拦下。效应量代替形容词。
tagline_en: Before you write any conclusion, it forces your claim up a 3-rung ladder: observed → directional →.
desc_en: Writes findings in language the evidence can carry — the claim ladder (observed → directional → decision-support, never causal without a design), effect sizes over drama, banned phrasings. Use when writing any conclusion, report section, playbook, or public page from analysis results.
why_zh: 不是改措辞的润色器，是拦结论的关卡。它把「证据能撑到哪一级」变成硬约束。
why_en: Not a wording polisher — a gatekeeper. It turns 'how far can your evidence reach' into a hard constraint, with banned phrases.
limit_zh: 只认你贴进来的分析结果和统计量；没有效应量或置信区间它会追问，但不替你补做统计。只约束结论性文字，不碰方法章节和代码。
limit_en: Only works on analysis outputs you paste; it asks for effect sizes/CIs but won't run stats for you. Scopes to conclusion prose only — methods and.
title_en: Writes only what your evidence can carry
